summary: Loads what a scene's motion needs while the idle is on or a pose is held: the idle catalogue and clip, its face, the blink.

faults.when: The installation has no creator idle for this body.

lifetime: Per scene, while its idle is on or a pose is held.

x-friction.gap: Idle time, dangles and the blink advance on their own timers; exact replay needs them integrated over the frame source's dt only.
x-friction.closes: State integrated over frame time inside a runtime whose inputs are all sources.
